Body.Content:
The following controls for canvas apps are reaching general availability:

• Card gallery

• Persona

• Avatar group

• Metrics card

These controls provide reusable patterns for responsive record cards, individual and grouped identities, and key metrics. Makers supply data, presence values, and metric calculations through properties and Power Fx.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/modern-controls/modern-controls-reference

GA date: January CY2027
